en: A black‑and‑white landscape postcard showing a lakeside rural area with gently rolling fields and forests in the background. In the middle distance on a small peninsula or shore stands a prominent church with a tall steeple and a few surrounding buildings. The foreground shows the opposite shore with bushes and a fence line. At the top of the image there is printed text in a Scandinavian language.
